verdict.rationale: Missive documents a REST API, webhooks, UI integrations, and custom channels for developers (missive-docs-31/39/15), plus an official MCP server exposing conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts to AI apps like Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor (missive-docs-1/20, missive-probe-4). This gives AI-native users a documented, programmatic way to drive the product beyond the UI. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt (all probed and 404'd) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness.
